tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// stobs 'phrog nag po'i bsnyen sgrub bsdus pa bzhugs so//

ā di de wa ta na mo/ stobs 'phrog nag po'i bsnyen sgrub bsdus pa ni/ mchod pa dang sman rakta gtor ma rnams byin rlabs spyi ltar byas la/ mdun gyi maṇḍal bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ mdun gyi maṇḍal steng gi tshom bu lnga pad nyi dgra bgegs gdan re re las/ gdan dbus mar hūm̐ las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po stobs 'phrog nag po zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/ rtsa zhal nag pos mi ro za ba/ lhag ma g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar| steng zhal dud kha/ zhal re re dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum bsgrad cing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus shing ma mchu 'phyang ba/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa'i khrod du mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ phyag dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og ma ral gri dang*/ g.yon 'og ma mdung thung dang mi rus kyi phreng ba 'dzin cing*/ mchan khung g.yon du gter gyi bum pa 'chang ba/ ha ha dang*/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kṣiṃ kṣiṃ gi sgra sgrog pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ dar sna tshogs dang*/ mi'i rgyu ma dang*/ sbrul dang*/ tshangs skud dril bu g.yel khas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhengs pa/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du srin mo dmar mo/ rgyab tu siṅga lī ma ser mo| bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag /gcer bu spyan gsum khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs shing skra brdzes pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ thod rlon gyi do shal can/ rus pas brgyan cing g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhengs pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus rol pa'i 'khor du pho nya mi gdug pa'i tshogs mtha' yas pas bskor ba/ gtso 'khor lnga'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ dang*/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ gangs ti se| siṅga gling*/ po ta la/ kha'u brag rdzong la sogs pa nas rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ sbyar ba'i spos bsregs rol mo dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ */ mi rtog dbyings las thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig /srid pa gur chen brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas nas// bde gshegs bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can// rdo rje nag po chen po gshegs su gsol// sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs pa// phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren no// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol| |oṃ ma hā kā lā tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ sngags gong ma'i wā ra'i mthar/ ma hā rakta arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ mchod yon dbul/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ lce la bdud rtsi blud cing*/ wā ra'i mthar/ badzra sa ma ya pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ ba lingta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal sde/ bi ma la gupta/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ ratna kīrti/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ rje sa chen nas rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhan chen byams pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bar gyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ bcol ba'i phrin las thams cad da lta nyid du 'grub par mdzod/ ces brjod/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ lha rnams kyi ljags 'od kyi sbu gu rdo rje'i rnam pa can gyis gtor ma drangs shing gsol bas mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ sngags ring thung gang rung yum sngags de wī dang bcas pa'i mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo sogs btags pa ci rigs dang 'khor la/

oṃ sarba yakṣa/ rakṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsi/ ma ti ga ṇa i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes dbul/ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ dgra bgegs bkug cing bsgral ba yi// dmar chen khrag gi arghaṃ 'di// zhal bzhi 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol// oṃ ma hā kā lā tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes thams cad 'dra ba la/ rkang pa gnyis par/ dbang po lnga yi me tog 'di// arghaṃ gyi gnas su/ puṣpaṃ= sha chen gsur gyi bdug spos 'di// dhū paṃ= tshil chen zhun gyi mar me 'di// ā lo ke= mkhris chen sbyar ba'i dri chab 'di// gandhe= sha khrag rus pa'i zhal zas 'di// nai wi dye= rkang gling thod rnga'i rol mo 'di// shapad= hūm̐ */ gzhan yang mnyes pa'i mchod pa ni// bdud rtsi sman dang dmar chen khrag /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di// zhal bzhi 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā ru dhī ra sarba pū dza pra tītstsha swā hā/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum rab bsgyur zhing*// mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba// sgra sgrog dril bu'i phreng bas brgyan pa yi// gzhon nu'i lus 'chang bgegs 'joms khyod la 'bul// du ma'i ming can drag po'i phreng ba can// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyis bgegs 'joms shing*// brkyang bskum glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer can// mdung thung gri gug bum thod 'dzin la bstod| |'jigs byed myur 'gro tshangs skud mi mgo yi// phreng ba 'dzin cing sa gsum skrag byed pa// kṣiṃ kṣiṃ sgra sgrog srin po'i gzugs 'dzin pa// dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba khyod la bstod| |khyod kyi yum chen g.yung mo gtum mo dang*// sring mo siṅga lī yi dgyes pa bskyed// gtso mo klu bdud kyis bsdus dregs pas bskor// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bdag bstod do// ces bstod/

bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying kha'i sngags kyi phreng ba thon/ mgon po'i zhal du zhugs/ snying khar nyi gdan la hūm̐ nag por sngags phreng gis bskor ba la thim pas thugs rgyud bskul rang gi 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub/ de nas dbye nas mgon po'i sku'i dbyibs rgyud lte ba nas thon rang gi lte bar zhugs nas snying ga'i sa bon la thim par gyur par bsam| sngags ring ci 'grub bzlas rjes/ sngags thung gang mos 'bad de bzla'o// thun mthar gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ sman raka sgron/ tshil chen gyi mar me bltams sha chen gyi spos bsregs shing*/ hūm̐ */ srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan gdong bzhi pa// yum chen 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas// lcam dral khyod kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i// zhing skyong sde brgyad dregs pa 'khor dang bcas// dam can srung ma sprul pa yang sprul tshogs// 'dir bzhugs gzhi bdag gnyan po 'khor bcas rnams// tshur gshegs sngon gyi dam bca' rjes dgongs la// gtor ma ri rab rgya mtshor mnyam pa'i tshogs| |zhim pa'i bza' btung spod kyis bran pa dang*// me tog spos dang mar me dri chab bcas// bzhed dgu'i longs spyod phun tshogs 'byung ba 'di// gsol zhig rol cig tshims shig tshim par rol// ji ltar phul ba bzhin du bzhes nas kyang*// rnal 'byor bdag la bar du gcod pa yi// gdug cing sdang sems 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs dang*// lam la bar du gcod pa'i bdud rigs rnams/ /mthu stobs nyams shing sgrol la zhal du gsol/ /gang yang bdag sogs bstan 'dzin de dag la// nyid kyis rjes dgongs bcol ba'i las mdzad de// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub kun stsal nas// bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du sgrubs// srid zhi dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i mthu dang ldan par mdzod// ces dang*/
'dod gsol gang 'dod kyang sbyar ro/ /zhes pa 'bri gung chos kyi grags pas bris so// //
